title: Confidence intervals for performance estimates in brain MRI segmentation
mechanism: Measures CI width of mean Dice vs test size and spread, parametric vs bootstrap.
adaptation: Bootstrap CIs of per-cell crack IoU on val-54 and OOF-532; show readers how wide a 49-cell CI is for EL cracks.
min_experiment: Arm: bootstrap CI on val and OOF. Metric: CI width. Kill: reporting only.
evidence: R (companion ISBI 2023 doi:10.1109/isbi53787.2023.10230401): about 8 Dice points CI width for 20 test cases at SD ~0.10.

alt_notes.adaptation: Compute the per-cell crack IoU SD on clean-49 and E1 and the CI half-width. Derive how many sealed-test cells give +/-0.01 for crack and inactive, then size the new test and E1 sets from that.
alt_notes.min_experiment: From the existing 5 house seeds: CI half-width of crack and inactive IoU on clean-49. Decision line: if the half-width > 0.02, the headline score must be OOF CV over 532 cells plus E1, not test-49 alone.
